How it works

Business Documents

NovaShop stores its policies and product details in internal documents that the AI can reference.

Chunking

Large documents are split into meaningful chunks so the system can find the most relevant information quickly.

Embeddings

The system converts text into numerical representations so it can match meaning, not just exact words.
